datasets.name: ODS_bal_spr_parts
datasets.sql:
select part, partname, part||''||partname as SEARCH,substr(part ,0,2) as part1  from bal_spr_parts  where part is not null


order by part

datasets.name: ODS_bal_spr_groups
datasets.sql:
select grp,grpname,grp||''|| grpname as SEARCH, substr(grp,0,2) as ger1 from bal_spr_groups where grp is not null

--and accgroup=:ddd



order by grp

datasets.name: ODS_Bal_spr1
datasets.sql:
select bal_cn,balname, bal_cn||''||balname as SEARCH  from bal_spr1 where length (bal_cn)>3  




order by bal_cn
